name: Wandercraft Calvin-40
summary: A French bipedal industrial robot with two arms, built on self-balancing exoskeleton technology, for moving boxes and crates in factories; first series deliveries expected in H1 2027.

germany.statusNote: No purchase, reservation or price offered: Wandercraft (Paris) runs demos and proof-of-concept tests on request; first series delivery expected in H1 2027. Wandercraft reports 12 customers but names only Renault Group; no German customer found.

sellers.name: Wandercraft
sellers.note: Demo request form on the Calvin page.

specs.label: Lift payload kg
specs.conditions: maker statement reported by trade press; a future version is expected to reach 50 kg

notes: Maker names heavy loads, boxes and crates, material flow between workstations; precise picking and kitting is being added.
Certifiable safety system for work without physical barriers (maker claim); target failure rate below 1 in 1,000.
Product image shows it without end effector; end effectors and payload not published.
